entry.author: Auckland Museum
entry.summary:
We recently hosted trailblazer and cultural icon in Pacific contemporary art, Fatu Feu’u in conversation with Dr. Albert Refiti. 

Ngā Kākano: Fatu Feu'u - Art is my culture and culture is in my art, was a journey with Fatu from his roots in Poutasi, Samoa, through his pioneering rise in Aotearoa, to overcoming barriers as one of the first Pacific artists to break onto the art scene. We heard the powerful story behind the emergence of Pacific Arts in the late 1980s and were inspired by Fatu’s passion for nurturing the next generation of artists.

----

Housed in one of New Zealand's finest heritage buildings, Auckland Museum is the cultural and spiritual touchstone for the many races that inhabit this beautiful land, and the first stop for anyone wishing to gain an insight into New Zealand and its peoples. Priceless Māori treasures and amazing natural history.
